evidence.note: Upper fresh-food door is shut and flush.
Hand is pulling the door and the illuminated interior becomes visible.
Door is fully open with the interior and door bins exposed.
Refrigerator remains fully open.
Hand swings the refrigerator door toward the closed position.
Door is shut and flush again.

events.object_description: Upper fresh-food door of the stainless-steel refrigerator; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Both wooden cabinet leaves above the cooktop are closed.
The left-hand leaf has been swung open, exposing the cabinet interior.
Left-hand leaf remains open.
Hand is completing the closure of the left-hand leaf.
Left-hand leaf is flush with the cabinet front.

events.object_description: Left-hand leaf of the double wooden cabinet above the cooktop/range hood; open is on.

evidence.note: Right-hand cabinet leaf remains closed while the left leaf is open.
Hand is swinging the right-hand leaf outward.
Both cabinet leaves are visibly open.
Right-hand leaf is still projecting outward beside the exposed interior.
Hand is finishing closure at the center seam.
Both cabinet leaves are fully closed and flush.

events.object_description: Right-hand leaf of the double wooden cabinet above the cooktop/range hood; open is on.

evidence.note: Uppermost drawer immediately right of the range is closed.
Hand reaches the drawer pull to begin opening it.
Drawer is open with stored boards and utensils exposed.
Drawer remains extended.
Hand begins pushing the drawer inward.
Drawer is closed and flush again.

events.object_description: Uppermost storage drawer immediately to the right of the range; extended/open is on.

notes: Open or extended is treated as on. Four distinct movable parts are counted: the refrigerator door, two independently manipulated cabinet leaves, and one drawer. The cabinet-leaf closure assignments are slightly uncertain because both leaves are closed within closely sampled frames.
scene_description: A kitchen traversal in which the camera wearer opens a refrigerator, separately opens both leaves of an upper cabinet above the cooktop, opens a nearby drawer, and later closes these parts.
